name: Paraphrase set (synthetic)
purpose: Measure whether embedding similarity finds rewritten duplicates that word overlap misses, and whether it wrongly joins distinct genuine reviews on the same topics.
note: All text written for this project in October 2026; no real property, reviewer or platform data. 'cluster' is ground truth for evaluation only; detection never reads it.

clusters.A: best hotel in the region, amazing staff, perfect rooms, top rating (positive campaign)
clusters.B: rude manager, dirty room, overcharged, never again (negative campaign)
clusters.C: lakefront balcony, gourmet breakfast, spa, best vacation ever (fabricated amenities)

reviews.text: Absolutely the best hotel in Northern Michigan, amazing staff and perfect rooms, five stars all the way!
Hands down the top place to stay in the whole region. The team were wonderful and our room was flawless. Full marks from us.
Nowhere else up north comes close. Incredible people working here and not a thing wrong with the accommodation. Ten out of ten.
You will not find a finer inn anywhere in the north. Superb service and immaculate quarters. Highest possible rating.
The manager was rude to us, the room was filthy, and they charged us more than the quoted price. Never staying here again.
Awful attitude from the person in charge, grime everywhere in our suite, and the bill came out above what we were told. We are done with this place.
Management treated us with contempt, housekeeping clearly skipped our unit, and the final invoice exceeded the agreed rate. Avoid.
Unpleasant owner, unclean lodging, surprise fees on checkout. Would not return under any circumstances.
Our balcony looked right over the lake, breakfast was gourmet, the spa was heavenly, best vacation of our lives.
Waking up to the water from our private terrace, a chef quality morning meal, and a blissful massage. The greatest holiday we have ever taken.
Lake views from the deck, five star dining at breakfast, and a world class wellness centre. A trip we will never top.
Terrace facing the shoreline, exquisite breakfast spread, relaxing spa treatments. Nothing will ever beat this getaway.
Room 204 faces the marina and we watched the ferry come in each morning. Breakfast is pastries and coffee only, nothing hot.
Staff were helpful when our key card stopped working at midnight. Beds are firm. Parking filled up by six.
Clean room, quiet hallway, and the walk to the docks took five minutes. Wifi dropped during our evening calls.
The heater clicked all night and the shower pressure was weak. Front desk offered to move us but the inn was full.
Breakfast ran out before eight on Saturday. The cinnamon rolls were good while they lasted.
We paid the midweek rate and felt it was fair for a harbor town in July. Room was dated but spotless.
Thin walls. We could hear the family next door until eleven. Otherwise a comfortable stay with a nice view.
Check in took twenty minutes because one person was covering the desk and the phone. The room itself was fine.
Housekeeping left fresh towels daily and the bathroom was immaculate. No complaints about cleanliness at all.
Our second floor room overlooked the parking lot, not the water, which the booking page did not make clear.
The lobby coffee at six in the morning was a nice touch before our fishing charter. Would stay again.
Small room, large window, sunset over the harbor. Breakfast was average. Good value overall.
